questions.q: The training workshop begins ______ 8:30 a.m. sharp.
Our annual sales conference is held ______ October every year.
questions.exp: 月份用 in：in October。日期才用 on（on October 12）。

questions.q: Please submit your timesheet ______ 5 p.m. on Friday.
questions.exp: 「最晚週五下午五點」是期限，用 by。until 是持續到某時，期限不用 until。

questions.q: The power was out ______ two hours this morning.
questions.exp: 後面是數字＋時間（two hours），講持續多久用 for；during 接事件或期間的名稱。

questions.q: Several flights were canceled ______ the snowstorm.
questions.exp: the snowstorm 是名詞片語，表示原因用 because of；because 後面要接子句。

questions.q: Applications received ______ the deadline will not be considered.
questions.exp: 截止日之後才收到的不受理：after the deadline。

questions.q: There has been a steady increase ______ the number of online orders.
questions.exp: 後面是增加的東西（the number of online orders），用 increase in；of 接增加的幅度（an increase of 20%）。

questions.q: The meeting room is ______ the third floor, next to the elevators.
questions.exp: 樓層用 on：on the third floor。

questions.q: ______ the heavy traffic, Mr. Park arrived at the meeting on time.
questions.exp: 塞車、卻準時到，是相反的兩件事；後面是名詞片語，用 Despite。Although 要接子句。

questions.q: All employees must comply ______ the company's data security policy.
